notes:
- **A new model for the live transcript on this PC shows words as they are spoken, with far fewer mistakes.** Nemotron streaming (English only, free, private) is a 662 MB download for PCs fast enough to run it. After the download A9 Voice times it on your PC; where it keeps up, Automatic uses it (a model on your graphics card still goes first), and you can pick it under **Settings › Notes › Live window › Live transcript by**. See [Words as they are spoken](/docs/live-window/#words-as-they-are-spoken).
- **Nobody gets a download they didn't ask for.** A PC that would use the model that reads a piece at a time sees one offer on that page and once in the Live window, with **Download** and **Not now**. In a meeting, a model that can't keep up for a minute hands the live transcript back to the lighter model, says so once and loses no line.
- Savings says a model on your PC can write the live transcript **a moment behind** when it is this one, a few seconds behind for the others, and NVIDIA's licence line is in About and the manual.
